exclusions: Only items tied to a 2026 regular-season home date from p0/homegames-nfl.json were counted. Pages or paths carrying 2025 (for example /gameday/2025/*, /tickets/2025/*, 2025 Salute to Service hometown hero text) were excluded by year in URL, byline date, or body text. Preseason items (August 2026, /preseason_* or /pre/ paths, 'Preseason Week N' guides) were excluded by path and date. Away-game watch parties and off-site fan fests were excluded because they are not on a home date. Rolling next-game pages were tied to a date only when the page body or its section banner named the opponent or kickoff time that matches one home date. Saints specifics: 2025 Gameday Guides and /tickets/2025/* pages excluded by year; 2026 Preseason Week 1 guide excluded by title; training camp poster excluded as preseason; Saints 5K (9/26) is not a game date; Drew Brees Ring of Honor and Legend of the Game are recognition and not counted.
notes: Dated count of 7 = 9/27 coin, 9/27 commemorative Dome Foam cup, 10/5 Domecoming theme, 10/5 rally towel, 10/5 Bud Light souvenir cup (with purchase), 10/11 Brees banner, 10/11 Crown Royal sampling and giveaways. Strict giveaway-only count is 3 (coin, towel, banner). The guide URLs are per-game news slugs, not a fixed page, so the config needs news discovery (news sitemap or the club news feed filtered on 'Gameday Guide') rather than one static URL; the Week 4 guide was missing from the news sitemap, so sitemap-only discovery would miss some. Next home games: 10/25 vs Steelers is played in Paris (Stade de France), then 11/8 Browns at the Superdome.
